rules.action: Deploy distal stent first, work proximally. Plan overlap zones (≥3mm, avoid side branches). Post-dilate each segment with NC balloon before deploying the next.
Ultra-thin strut DES preferred — facilitates SB rewiring and reduces jailing. Size to distal MV reference diameter (Murray's law).

Size to distal MV reference for bifurcation cases; proximal reference for shaft/ostial disease. Proximal edge must not protrude into the aorta. Post-dilate with NC balloon sized to proximal LM. Confirm MSA with IVUS.
BMS and DES are equally effective in SVG PCI. Use slightly undersized diameter with generous length. Consider prolonged DAPT based on DAPT score.
Target complete revascularisation where feasible; stage if haemodynamic reserve is limited. Minimise stent length per vessel to reduce ischaemic time.
Accept a longer procedure to ensure an optimal stent result. Discuss bailout strategy for abrupt closure with the team before wiring.
rules.caution: A failed stent in the only remaining coronary is catastrophic — there is no haemodynamic reserve for an inadequate result.
